findings.decision: The author describes a partial formalization of the statement of Deligne association, not a proved association or purity theorem. No replacement for the open Dubon endpoint.

The described Lean results are the first two vertical finite-field moments over all Weierstrass pairs, including singular pairs. This is a different averaging domain from prime equidistribution for a fixed non-CM modular form.
The described Sato-Tate/symmetric-power consequences concern CM curves and CM newforms. They do not match the required non-CM full modular branch; no dependency closure certified here.
Older Lean 3 modular-form definitions and Eisenstein work; author description explicitly leaves modularity unfinished. Native completed modular infrastructure remains preferable.

conclusion: This additional bounded search yielded no verified direct non-CM Sato-Tate, full modular Galois association/purity, or all-higher-symmetric-power continuation endpoint. The certified patching and Chebotarev ports remain the concrete reusable gains; no global nonexistence claim is made.
